content:
Maya Patel: quick sync — we need to decide whether to prioritize quantity (fast enrollments) or quality (tight-fit partners) for the next DP wave. tradeoffs: speed vs signal depth. 
Alex Monroe: +1. my leaning = quality. fewer partners but deeper feedback -> better safety/edgecase coverage.
Liam Rodriguez: leaning quality too. ops cost for handholding scales poorly but signal is actionable. also helps model onboarding.
Sara Kim: can we do a hybrid? e.g., 12 slots: 6 deep-study partners + 6 rapid-feedback partners. staggered starts.
Maya Patel: I like staggered. experiment hypothesis: mixed cohort yields same breadth in half the time and better long-term fixes. need success metrics though.
Priya Desai: proposed success metrics: 
- Qual deep cohort: 4 validated bugs fixed per partner, 3 follow-ups scheduled
- Rapid cohort: 60% product usage in 2 weeks, NPS >= 7
- Overall: time-to-actionable-issue <= 10 days
Alex Monroe: should add a scoring rubric for recruiting so we can sort quickly. tiny form.
Liam Rodriguez: suggested rubric (quick): ImpactFit (1-5), TechComplexity (1-5), OpsCommitment (1-5), ComplianceRisk (1-5). cutoff 12+ for deep cohort.
Maya Patel: nice. let's embed that in outreach. keep message short.
Sara Kim: draft outreach template (short):
```
Hey {{name}} — we’re running a short private pilot for a new Redwood inference feature. 30-min session + prototype access. small stipend. Interested? Reply with 1-2 times that work.
```
Priya Desai: can we A/B the incentive? $100 vs $200 for rapid vs deep? measure conversion.
Alex Monroe: yes do that. also track why they decline (one-liner) so we can tune.
Maya Patel: logistics: recruiting owner = @Priya, intake form owner = @Alex, scheduling = @Sara. Ops note: eng capacity only 3 deep slots per sprint.
pm-bot: scheduled reminder set for 3 days to follow up unresponsive leads (:bell:).
Liam Rodriguez: question — what’s our rollout gate? i suggest gated launch if deep cohort reports >80% fix-verification for top 3 regressions.
Maya Patel: gate noted. final checklist for go/no-go: cohort completion rate, median time-to-actionable-issue, NPS baseline. if all green -> expand to dedicated beta.
Priya Desai: I'll build candidate spreadsheet and include rubric + incentive column. sharing first draft by EOD tomorrow.
Alex Monroe: I'll make the intake Typeform and include the rubric as hidden scoring.
Sara Kim: i can draft scheduling templates and onboarding checklist.
Maya Patel: perfect. anyone opposed to pilot structure? speak now or DM. otherwise i'll post invite text and intake link later today. :sparkles:
